rule.name: RemoveByKeyDropsNewerValue
rule.message: Remove only the entry this callback owns: map.remove(key, value) (or map.remove(key, this) inside the value class), or computeIfPresent(key, (k, current) -> current == value ? null : current). By the time this callback runs, another caller may have stored a newer value under the same key, and remove(key) deletes that one: an active request or a valid connection disappears. An exception fits when the key can never be stored again while this callback is pending.
